static_traits.name: 李丹娜
static_traits.medical_history: without类似问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、有条理；能回忆并量化体验（如对活动愉悦度打分）；配合度高、愿意尝试重构思维；Low mood、描述“空虚”“悲伤”；思维中出现“何必呢”“not会好起来”等消极自动化思维；Neutral attitude。

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直感到极度抑郁，甚至连我曾经喜欢的桨板运动也not再带来任何快乐。这种抑郁大约在六个月前开始，尽管我尝试继续参与过去带来快乐的活动，症状仍逐渐加重，我without法找到具体原因。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this depression severely affects my quality of life and my enjoyment of activities I once liked.

core_beliefs: 我without法从任何事情中获得快乐

special_situations.event: 尝试进行桨板运动时，曾经喜欢的活动not再带来快乐
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果活动not能立刻让我感觉好转，就have not意义；这说明我not会好起来
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces self to keep trying paddleboarding, hoping repeated participation will bring back the joy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 何必呢？这not会让我感觉好一点

special_situations.event: Over the past six months, still feels bored when participating in other previously enjoyed leisure activities (watching movies, reading)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连我曾经喜欢的活动也not再让我快乐，就说明have not任何东西能让我快乐
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Participates reluctantly but is emotionally detached, hard to engage
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not任何东西能让我快乐了

special_situations.event: When considering whether to share his depressive feelings with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达抑郁，他们not会理解，只会让我“赶紧好起来”，这会让我更难受
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing the true extent in depth, keeping silent and bearing it alone

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted, to be able to experience joy and vitality again
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被轻描淡写或negate（被要求“快点好起来”），从而加重痛苦与Loneliness感
defense_goal: 通过保持沉默与not披露来减少被negate或受伤的风险

object_relations.object_representation: Bystanders who may look down on one or demand one 'cheer up'

manifestations: 描述参与桨板、看电影、阅读等活动时“毫Meaninglessness”“空虚”“悲伤”
过去热爱的活动如今“have not任何快乐”，体验显著下降（8–9分降至1–2分）
Depression has lasted six months; hard to gain a sense of meaning from daily life
outcomes: 降低参与度与投入感，Decreased quality of life

manifestations: 有几位亲密朋友但not yet分享抑郁的真实程度
担心朋友not理解或让自己“快点好起来”而选择not披露
outcomes: 社会支持难以发挥作用，主观Loneliness感增加

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self; that is, the individual redirects the energy originally meant to be sent outward back toward the self, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language expressions include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it' and 'I should not trouble others'.
manifestations: not向朋友表达抑郁的真实程度，选择沉默独自承受
对外求助减少，把痛苦向内吞咽

positive_force: Still tries to participate in activities (tried paddleboarding multiple times in the past six months)
Willing to seek professional help and cooperate with cognitive restructuring exercises
Has a certain self-observation and quantification ability (able to recall and rate past and present pleasure levels)
Has some social support resources (a few friends he can confide in)
negative_force: Depressive mood persists and broadly affects interest and pleasure
认知偏差明显（过度概括、非黑即白、对not yet来的负性预测）
对外部支持的回避与not披露，导致The support system has difficulty functioning
将当前负性情绪视为客观事实（情绪化推理），进一步ReinforcementMeaninglessness感

target_behavior.behavior: Anhedonia and negative predictions appear when participating in once-loved leisure activities (such as paddleboarding, watching movies, reading)
antecedent: 准备或计划参与休闲活动的时刻
target_behavior.core_reason: Six months of persistent depression accompanied by cognitive biases (overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, emotional reasoning), taking the present sense of emptiness as fact and making negative predictions about the effects of activities
target_behavior.function: 逃避失望与not适，降低投入以避免再次证实“Meaninglessness”的体验
target_behavior.consequence: Quality of life markedly declines, interest and pleasure disappear or markedly decrease, and socializing and daily life are affected
